proposed_fixes.title: Investigate duplicate Win/Alt state after swap
proposed_fixes.root_cause: The swap may forward physical Win while injecting remapped modifiers or fail to balance synthesized key-up, leaving both states visible to Windows.
plan: Reproduce the swap and capture physical/injected key transitions and shell shortcut outcomes.
Trace suppression and synthesized modifier release paths for both swap directions.
Correct only the confirmed duplicate-forwarding or key-up imbalance; add coverage for sequential presses and release order.
verification: Check on-screen keyboard after each release and test Win+G through both physical key paths.
Run modifier-remap tests for both directions, key-up ordering, and repeated presses.
